question_results.description: Exactly one result for each effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id, including prospectively added_tests. Use the exact test_id as question_id; do not invent aliases or merge tests into one result. Detailed reasoning may be shared through exact source references. Related results may link the same compact exhibit with complete exact case/metric mappings; no separate table is required for every test.

question_id.description: The exact effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id answered by this result, including prospectively added_tests. This is the existing protocol identifier, not a new question alias.

test_ids.description: The singleton array [question_id], where question_id is the exact effective protocol test_id. Do not group multiple tests in one result.

case_ids.description: All and only effective protocol case IDs whose test_ids contains this exact question_id. Retain unfavorable and unrun cases; report invalidated observations separately without dropping their declared cases.

relevance_markdown.description: Explain how this test's measured quantity answers the scientific question, distinguishing the true target from a surrogate score, bound or numerical reference.

examples: Illustrative negative result: In the tested contaminated setting, the method had larger mean absolute error than the baseline (0.18 versus 0.12 outcome units; 200 usable paired datasets). The paired difference was 0.06 with Monte Carlo standard error 0.01. This argues against the intended robustness benefit in this setting, not against every possible use.

Illustrative inconclusive result: The estimated error difference was -0.003 outcome units with Monte Carlo standard error 0.008 across 40 usable paired datasets. The observed ordering does not establish improvement; the small experiment cannot distinguish the methods reliably.

Illustrative partial result: The implementation reproduced the deterministic reference solution to the declared tolerance. Performance and tuning sensitivity were not run within the authorized budget, so implementation agreement provides no evidence of advantage over the baseline.

Illustrative unassessed result: No computation was performed for the heavy-tail setting. Its effect on accuracy and uncertainty coverage remains unknown; the Gaussian comparison cannot answer this question.
answer_markdown.description: Start with the direct finding and tested scope for this exact test, including magnitude, units, usable counts and uncertainty when measured and applicable. Follow the supplied scientific-explanation and claims-and-evidence references. Explain the actual target, loss or performance measure and link the compact exhibit without narrating every cell. Give any explanation of a negative result through an established analytical relation or recorded diagnostic when available; otherwise leave its cause unresolved. Other required fields add distinct design, uncertainty or qualification needed for inspection. Preserve attempted/returned denominators, inconclusive or negative evidence and synthetic/actual-data scope; absent demonstrated benefit or nonsignificance does not establish no benefit or equivalence.

comparison_markdown.description: Explain the recorded contrast and its meaning for the intended benefit, linking the primary compact exhibit rather than replaying its rows or the answer. State comparator information and whether the setting can distinguish the claimed mechanism; coincident procedures support a check, not evidence of no benefit from their difference. Preserve alternatives, compatible targets, units, conditions and uncertainty. A paired selective-output contrast needs saved differences on the same stated subset, its count and uncertainty. Equal counts alone do not establish matched membership; marginal means over different returned subsets imply neither that contrast nor unconditional superiority. Observed comparisons do not establish an untested explanation. Exact links authorize no new contrast.

conditions_markdown.description: The tested data-generating and observation conditions and assumptions that bound this answer. State what stays fixed and what changes across settings, with exact protocol references rather than a duplicate setup account.

design_markdown.description: Explain what one independent replication contains, comparator fairness, paired or independent repetitions and planned versus exploratory scope, with exact protocol references. Define reported quantities and their averaging subsets where first needed. Primary setup explains data generation, observations, replication, comparators and measures. Code-specific agreement and engineering checks remain in the protocol or implementation reader unless essential to the comparison. Keep engineering pilots and finite code checks distinct from main repeated-simulation evidence unless they are the scientific subject.

reliability_markdown.description: Explain usable, failed, invalidated and unrun observations and how they affect the conclusion, retaining attempted/returned denominators. Distinguish completed no-output procedures from execution failures and unstarted work. Conditional returned quality is undefined without output, not zero; do not invent a deployment fallback. Failed or unresolved truth classifications cannot silently count as successful or safe.

uncertainty_markdown.description: Name the recorded statistical uncertainty, units, relevant repetition/subset count and interval type, sidedness and confidence level when applicable. Unavailable uncertainty is not zero; an all-attempted event interval is not a conditional-on-selection interval. Keep numerical reference error separate: an enclosure crossing a threshold leaves classification unresolved, and an estimated reference retains statistical uncertainty. Explain unknown classifications' effect on the conclusion without treating them as safe or failed observations.

limitations_markdown.description: State the scientific uncertainty, untested regimes or deviations that bound the answer, without retelling it. A zero count does not prove impossibility; an ideal analytical screen is not observed power or actual return. Link detailed findings; the answer owns the source-backed explanation of the principal result.

decision_implication_markdown.description: State the concise consequence for development or use under the researcher objective, without repeating the primary answer or assigning a preference. Preserve source-backed scientific conditions; advice does not authorize another run.

next_steps_markdown.description: Name the next resolving question, why it matters and the appropriate phase. State that unperformed work remains unperformed.

summary_markdown.description: Final actual-data outcome and scope/omission reason. When analyzed, explain fitting the same model interface to the mapped supplied data and interpreting diagnostics without invented truth or causal identification.
